title: Existential quantifier
summary: Existential quantification asserts that at least one permitted witness satisfies a condition.

content.plain: Existential quantification asserts that at least one permitted witness satisfies a condition.
content.exact: Given formula φ(x), ∃x φ(x) is satisfied in M when some domain element assigned to x makes φ hold.
content.example: ∃p∈ℕ such that p is prime and p>100.
content.caveat: Classical existence and constructive exhibition of a witness need not be treated identically.
